scope: All steps of the three Cambridge Ti c-axis examples; zero-based step indices. Illustrative c-axis extension of the paper.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Import original Oxford CPR/CRC pair; retain native crystal basis and measured arrays.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Apply the documented Oxford 180 degree sample-Y spatial correction, with no extra crystal/Euler rotation.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Mark only Error=0, Bands>0, Phases=1 pixels as indexed; retain all original values.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy raw Phases so the analysis mask can exclude invalid cells without altering imported phases.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Name the copied phase array AnalysisPhases.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Set excluded analysis phases to zero; keep raw Phases unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Convert imported Euler angles in radians to quaternions without changing crystal axes.

filters.pipeline: (01) Cambridge Ti Import and C-Axis Directions.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Project alpha-Ti c axes into the corrected sample frame; excluded pixels remain undefined.

filters.purpose: Save the complete checkpoint for the next example and independent checks.
Read the complete predecessor checkpoint.
Find face-connected full-orientation grains at the author-script 7 degree tolerance; IDs are NX-specific.
Measure grain pixel counts and two-dimensional areas; unit z spacing is a software placeholder.
Mark grains with measured area greater than 1 square micrometer for an optional paper-like display cohort; retain every grain.
Assign each positive grain its analysis phase; row zero remains background.
Compute symmetry-aware grain AvgQuats for neighbor c-axis comparisons.
Build the face-contiguous grain graph; single-layer shared areas represent boundary lengths under unit z spacing.
Compute antipodally aligned mean cell c axes for each grain.
Measure each indexed cell c-axis deviation from its grain AvgCAxes in degrees.
Measure neighbor c-axis angles from AvgQuats; this reference differs from AvgCAxes.
Save the complete checkpoint for the next example and independent checks.
Read the complete predecessor checkpoint.
Segment face-connected cell c axes at the same 7 degree threshold for visual comparison with grains.
Group adjacent grains by pairwise c-axis alignment; fixed seed and unrandomized IDs make reruns comparable.
Reset excluded cell parent labels to zero after native grouping.
Identify background grain row zero for parent-label cleanup.
Reset background feature parent label to zero; leave the unused parent row in place.
Measure populated grouped-parent areas from corrected cell IDs; skip empty parent rows in interpretation.
Measure parent area divided by the unique member-plus-neighbor area; a dimensionless 2D neighborhood fraction.
Save the complete checkpoint for the next example and independent checks.
